name: tachyons-cache
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while the session sits idle by re-reading the transcript prefix before the cache entry lapses

intervalSeconds.title: Ping interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: Idle time between warm-up pings. Keep it under the cache TTL: 270 for the 5 minute cache, about 3300 for the 1 hour cache.

maxPings.title: Max pings per idle stretch
maxPings.description: Stop warming after this many pings without a new turn.
